about: The copy and the Fly Types of the hook size chart's size rows (ticket 35). scripts/hook-chart/rows.mjs writes the rows between the chart page's two markers on every run, so change them here, never on the store. The copy is the reference design's (plan/design/src/reference.src.html, USES) and waits for Shaun's approval with the page copy; set the status to approved then.
